event_chain.summary: Misdelivery: report emailed with recipients' addresses visible

summary: On 30 July 2026 the Victorian Legislative Assembly Legal and Social Issues Committee emailed its final report on cults and coercive groups to a distribution list without hiding the recipients, exposing about 330 email addresses. The exposed people included survivors and witnesses who had made anonymous or confidential submissions, as well as representatives of the groups under inquiry. The committee chair called it an administrative error and apologised.
